text: seow: 'Strength and impulse both confirm.' Confirmation is not location. C19: on a parabolic move, exit; C11: a climax-zone entry must work almost at once or it was wrong. You write run_10d 54.22% leaves the support line very deep; my objection is not that line but the setup: no test, no first pullback, no contraction at this close (C2). What clears me: a first orderly pullback that holds structure, then I support the reclaim. Falsifier: two more sessions of gains with no reversal.
